terra.problem: The text does not say there was no conversation with the third servant.
The cup of tea breaks the food rule.
The explanation simply repeats the answer and ends with a generic observation. It has little of Papa Dorin's voice.
It says the servants were beaten, but the text says the third was wounded and thrown out. It does not say he was beaten.
The text gives the people's response but does not establish that nobody in the crowd cheered.
The text does not say anyone leaves, but that does not establish that nobody is heading for the exit.
The dropped-cookie joke makes light of Jesus' serious words about people being broken or crushed.
The text does not say nobody explained the parable to the leaders or that they understood it right away.
The passage does not say the people were all around Jesus.
The text says the leaders were afraid of the people, not that the crowd stopped them from arresting Jesus.
The text does not say the people were right there or that their presence held the leaders back. It says the leaders were afraid of them.
